label: Alpine Treemap
description: Alpine treemap — friendly mobile-marketing card: value-sized rounded tiles (squarified) filling the card, each labelled with its name + share, tiles fading in biggest→smallest. Standalone Alpine brand flavor. v2 rebuilds the geometry as a ratio layout (squarified nested splits + gap-as-inset) so it composes at any canvas without the absolute-placement precision blowup.

items.label: Items
items.description: Treemap items. Each: a label, a value (sizes the tile), an optional color.

valueMode.label: Value mode
valueMode.description: Second label line: percent share, raw value, or none.

showValue.label: Show value
showValue.description: Show the value / share line in each tile.

anim.renderMode.label: Render mode
anim.renderMode.description: "premium" (default): tiles + text fade in — a geq each. "light": the same cascade via free enable-gate pops — no geq, composable, cheap when nested.

anim.reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
anim.reduceMotion.description: Skip motion; render the final static card.

anim.introFrac.label: Intro length
anim.introFrac.description: Share of the clip the intro fills (the rest holds).

theme.slug.label: Producer slug
theme.slug.description: Producer template to seed tokens from (e.g. "@m0saic/theming/v1").

theme.namespace.label: Namespace
theme.namespace.description: Upstream alias to read tokens from. Default "theme".

theme.forceFetch.label: Force fetch
theme.forceFetch.description: Re-seed via the slug even if the namespace is populated.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Opt into a theme source. Uses the alpine preset by default; set a producer slug + namespace to pull shared design tokens. Explicit color props still win.

debugLayout.label: Debug layout
debugLayout.description: Dev-only: draw the layout contract (tile text fits its slot) instead of the card.
